claims.quote: PRRT2 is a presynaptic protein which seems to play an important role in exocytosis and neurotransmitter release.

Recent studies reported mutations in the gene encoding the proline-rich transmembrane protein 2 (PRRT2) to be causative for paroxysmal kinesigenic dyskinesia (PKD), PKD combined with infantile seizures (ICCA), and benign familial infantile seizures (BFIS).
